en.hubeali:
Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Ibn sama’at, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The divorce of the sick (man) is not allowed, but his marriage is allowed’.
en.sarwar: 4. Humayd ibn Ziyad has narrated from ibn Sama‘ah from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jabalah from ibn Bukayr from ‘Ubayd ibn Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One’s divorcing during his illness is not permissible, however, his marriage is permissible.’”
